name: Maître de réseau
description: Very old broad adult with weathered pale tan speckled head, deep brow grooves, one naturally shorter mandible tusk, long silver-black dreadlocks loosely tied at back. Sand-coloured heavy knee-length coat with stitched repairs and broad sash, matte bronze breast fitting, segmented forearm guards. Holds a practical round handwheel control valve in one hand, other supports a rolled pipe-network schematic made of blank etched metal sheets with no readable text. Mature steady authoritative stance.

Generate exactly ONE distinct adult Yautja HYDROLOGIST of the desert tribe 'Peuple des Citernes', full body including feet, all held equipment and dreadlocks, generous clear margin on all sides. Image 1 is reference only for desert tribal identity: practical sand-worn beige fabrics, dark leather straps, weathered bronze cistern engineering fittings and restrained turquoise-blue glass water containers. Image 2 is reference only for cinematic realistically hand-painted 2D game rendering, anatomical proportions, readable idle pose, camera looking slightly down, three-quarter view FACING RIGHT. Do not reproduce the multiple-figure atlas. This is one new individual, not the reference person with a recolour. Maintain unmistakable Predator/Yautja adult anatomy: ridged alien cranium, four mandibular jaws unless concealed by described work mask, long tendril dreadlocks, clawed hands, digitigrade-looking clawed alien feet. Practical water systems specialist, no combat action. Delicate texture, crisp readable silhouette, internally consistent soft overhead-left lighting, no colored rim glow. Actual transparent alpha background, no backdrop, no landscape, no ground plane or platform, no ground contact shadow, no text, no labels, no symbols pretending to be letters, no watermark, no border, no collage. One character only. Neither head, foot nor tool may be cropped.
Individual design: Very old broad adult with weathered pale tan speckled head, deep brow grooves, one naturally shorter mandible tusk, long silver-black dreadlocks loosely tied at back. Sand-coloured heavy knee-length coat with stitched repairs and broad sash, matte bronze breast fitting, segmented forearm guards. revisionPrompt:
Edit IMAGE1, the complete original Yautja game sprite, with only a targeted correction of the uncovered FACE and its mandibular anatomy. IMAGE2 is the official 1987 Predator mechanical head photograph, used solely as exact facial anatomical reference.
PRESERVE the same full-body adult NPC identity: body height and build, every piece of clothing, fabric colors, armor, tools, harness, held objects, hands, feet, thick biological scalp tendrils, pose, lighting, and overall game rendering style. Lock everything from neck downward. Keep the entire original character and all held equipment visible inside transparent margins. Do not zoom in, crop, add scenery, ground, shadow, text, watermark, or a second person. Real alpha transparent background.
Correct the exposed head to ultra-faithful cinematic Yautja anatomy seen in image2: broad alien cranial dome and heavy orbital folds, small recessed alien eyes, reptilian granular mottled hide. No human nose bridge, no human lips, no human chin, no two nasal tubes. EXACTLY FOUR distinct EXTERNAL FLESHY MANDIBLE LOBES around a separate INNER TOOTHED MOUTH: two UPPER CHEEK lobes each ending in a short inward/downward tusk, plus two large LOWER fleshy jaw lobes each ending in a long tusk curving UPWARDS. Their fleshy bases must visibly belong to four separate jaw appendages. Do not replace these with two smooth hanging tubes or two ordinary cheek fangs. Relaxed slightly parted four jaws, neutral attentive NPC expression, enough face turned three-quarter toward viewer that ALL FOUR external mandibles can be read. Keep the original person's cranial proportions, skin color, distinguishing spots/scars and tendril arrangement as much as the anatomical fix permits. Biological thick dreadlock tendrils, not human hair.
The intended result is the same original full-body character after a precise facial-anatomy correction, retaining all non-face design details. Do not copy the photo background, clothes, logos or watermark.
